e.title: MGA 精算调查
e.summary: Broadstone×InsTech MGA 精算调查：MGA 精算能力的行业调查
e.body: Broadstone 与 InsTech 联合发起 MGA 精算调查（insurance-edge）：MGA（管理总代理）精算能力的行业调查——MGA 精算能力/需求的研究。对 RIAA：MGA 精算的行业调查——理解 MGA 业态（保险分销的新形态）对精算能力的需求；与 [[risk-radar-2026]]（风险雷达）配套：细分业态 + 行业全景；MGA 精算是新兴职业方向（再保/分销交叉）；细分市场求职/研究的参考。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：insurance-edge 报道确认（MGA 精算调查），未通读
e.summary_en: Broadstone×InsTech MGA actuarial survey: an industry survey of MGA actuarial capability
e.summary_hk: Broadstone×InsTech MGA 精算調查：MGA 精算能力的行業調查
e.body_en: Broadstone and InsTech jointly launched an MGA actuarial survey (insurance-edge): an industry survey of MGA (managing general agent) actuarial capability — research on MGA actuarial capability/demand. For RIAA: an industry survey of MGA actuarial work — understand the demand for actuarial capability in the MGA business model (a new form of insurance distribution); with [[risk-radar-2026]] (risk radar) it frames sub-segment + industry panorama; MGA actuarial work is an emerging career direction (reinsurance/distribution intersection); a reference for sub-segment jobs and research.
e.body_hk: Broadstone 與 InsTech 聯合發起 MGA 精算調查（insurance-edge）：MGA（管理總代理）精算能力的行業調查——MGA 精算能力/需求的研究。對 RIAA：MGA 精算的行業調查——理解 MGA 業態（保險分銷的新形態）對精算能力的需求；與 [[risk-radar-2026]]（風險雷達）配套：細分業態 + 行業全景；MGA 精算是新興職業方向（再保/分銷交叉）；細分市場求職/研究的參考。
